# TRS-80 Rev Z — Codespace
#
# The container builds the headless Verilator emulator on first open.
#
# ## Quick start
#
# 1. Put your Level II ROM at `roms/level2.hex`
# 2. Wait for the build task to finish (terminal, ~5 min)
# 3. Press F5 with the "TRS-80 Rev Z (Codespace FPGA)" config selected
#
# The machine auto-starts on folder open. Use the task palette for:
#   - TRS-80: Stop Machine
#   - TRS-80: Screen Dump
#   - TRS-80: Build Emulator (after RTL changes)
